description: This file defines a React functional component 'MCPConnectionTest' that tests and displays the connection status to a specified MCP server, including handling loading states, success, error display, and copying configuration details.

methods.name: testMCPConnection
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the MCP connection using provided form values and access token, updates state based on success or error.

methods.name: getCleanErrorMessage
methods.description: Processes an error message string to remove unnecessary parts and format it for display.

methods.name: formatMCPRequest
methods.description: Converts MCP configuration object to a formatted JSON string for display.
